intraday_caveat: The fall is measured to the screen instant, not to the close. Measured over 45 sessions: 86.4% of the worst 15 at 15:00 ET are still the worst 15 at the close (min 11 of 15), and the 15:00-to-close move on those names is a coin flip -- mean -0.24%, median 0.00%, sd 4.54%, 49.8% falling further. So the screen is cheap and the entry is near-free in expectation, but phase 0's base rates are CLOSE-to-close and this is not.
